resources.string: Normal loads its module from the active startup ramdisk. Use init_boot on this device. If init_boot supplies the ramdisk, patching boot alone may leave Normal uninstalled. Confirm to choose boot anyway. Ultra uses the boot kernel.
Normal filters modules during early ramdisk startup. Ultra filters in the boot kernel and needs one image. Optionally select vendor_boot to remove vr/vklp; flash its output too when selected.
Installs the startup filter in the selected target. Ultra patches boot; Normal patches the image containing the startup ramdisk.
Optional matching stock image for vr/vklp removal
The primary image includes the startup filter. A vendor_boot image is optional for removal.
